newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Summit encouraged by Aust, NZ sampling.
newsitem.headline: Summit encouraged by Aust, NZ sampling.

text.p: Summit Gold NL said on Thursday it had received "encouraging" results from its Valhalla uranium project in Queensland and its Carrick gold project in Otago, New Zealand.
Summit said its percussion and diamond drill programme was completed on the company's 50 percent controlled Valhalla uranium deposit.

Here, 787 metres of drilling improved the overall grade to 1.23 kilograms per tonne or 2.71 pounds per tonne of uranium oxide and expanded the known resource to over 27 million pounds of contained uranium oxide.
"Considerable upside remains at Valhalla with both the widths and grade of mineralisation increasing with depth, and the deposit remaining open in all directions," Summit said.
Resolute Ltd is the other partner in Valhalla.
Systematic soil sampling on the Carrick Gold Field in Central Otago had defined a large drill target.
Drill testing of the anomaly, which remains open to the south, is planned for the first quarter of 1997.
Meanwhile, joint venture partners Sons of Gwalia returned some promising gold intersections from drilling of the Cheritons project in Western Australia.
Full assay results are awaited from CRAE's first round of geochemical drilling on the Isa North project, Summit said.
